text: Materials: supply and return ductwork indoors of galvanised sheet steel; outdoor ductwork, louvres and casings of stainless steel 316L or aluminium with a marine coating system, or hot-dip galvanised with paint to ISO 12944 C5 H per ALP-EPC-00000-ME-SPC-0002; fan and motor casings with a marine coating and IP55 minimum protection (IP56 for outdoor motors); chilled water pipes of carbon steel with a paint system per the painting specification and cellular glass or closed cell elastomeric insulation with an aluminium jacket outdoors.
